title: The dissection — how six seats came out of one box
card: The method as six machines, and the gravity map: six seat capsules pulling on 24 part tiles across five sphere panels — the stroke is the pull, and 8 parts no seat wants stay visible.
lede: Six machines turn one subject into a page queue: 24 named parts, five spheres, six seats, six gravity worlds. The beat prose lives behind the machines; the gravity map shows the pull itself — click a seat and its world lights. The seats live on the Catan index.
handle: Spheres belong to the subject, seats belong to the audience — mix them and you get a 'strategy sphere', which is the reader leaking into the subject.
source: game numbers from the Catan base-game rules (3–4 player set); census, seat and world counts are this page's own dissection — recount them on this page.
